# IP Inspector

> Free, single-page IP lookup tool — geolocation, ISP/ASN, reverse DNS, and VPN/proxy/Tor detection for any IPv4/IPv6 address or domain.

Static site (no backend, no build step, no dependencies) at https://ip.hbenali.ovh — a single `index.html` calling public APIs directly from the browser. Shows your own public IP on load, resolves domains via DNS-over-HTTPS, includes an interactive map for the resolved location and a subnet/CIDR calculator, and keeps a local (browser-only) history of recent lookups.

## Pages
- [IP Inspector](https://ip.hbenali.ovh/): the tool itself.
